d1_selection_rule: Prefer 1.04 if causal execution, track coverage and portability checks pass. Record each other profile on the identical 96-cell no-gallery panel. An implementation failure cannot be relabelled an accuracy result. Any nominal replacement requires a written reason and preserves all rejected receipts; no cpWER-only winner selection.
reference_duration_policy: N1-frozen nested whole-clip prefixes; count unique estimated active samples and preserve honest prefix overrun, not repeated clips. Both encoders get identical waveform spans.
diagnostic_population: clean-source identities AVAILABLE at all three tiers, within each frozen roster; retain other identity shortages in denominator report
processed_positions: each existing position separate; never choose using Q
processed_E_span_policy: whole accepted captured file; source estimated active duration inherited, output activity not exact; no unsupported time projection

calibration.unit: one max score/margin per unique C source against fixed roster; withheld source identity defines stranger
calibration.threshold_rule: lowest score threshold satisfying empirical C false-known<=1%; margin is fixed before scoring, not tuned; report Wilson95 upper bound, identity clustering and lack of deployment guarantee
calibration.insufficient_evidence_policy: UNCALIBRATED_REJECT_ALL; curves only; never copy thresholds across model, enrollment/input domain, gallery roster, duration or preprocessing
calibration.processed_Q_transfer: clean C with processed Q is a domain-shift diagnostic only, cannot enable production naming

metrics.activity_overlap: include; speaker-time denominator; complete-reference scenes only
metrics.cpWER: per-scene concatenation in source turn order within reference identity and predicted turn order within anonymous track; optimal permutation with dummy streams; raw frozen ASR words; Unknown remains a hypothesis stream
metrics.return_mapping: evaluator-only maximum activity-overlap track per turn; ties/missing remain unresolved; correct merge/split never assumed from cast
metrics.label_only_ASR_invariance: ordered raw word sequence exact equality and SHA256 per scene/tap; formatted text separately checked
metrics.empty_control: inserted raw words and predicted activity seconds; WER undefined
metrics.incomplete_reference: retain target-only diagnostics and explicit all-speaker accuracy exclusion

resource_policy: No inference from this generator. Central owner schedules at most 2 CPU workers and 1 GPU owner; isolated resource receipts separate from concurrent screen.
truth_firewall: Runtime consumes AUDIO_ONLY.json and model-compatible gallery; evaluator Q identity/activity/transcript metadata never passed to predictor. Diagnostic externally defined Q windows are explicitly evaluator-only.
